description: Defines the CommandResult class and execute function for managing command execution and output handling in Android binder communication debugging.

classes.name: CommandResult
classes.description: Represents the result of executing a command, including exit code, signals, process ID, output strings, and pipes.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs the CommandResult to an ostream.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a command with specified arguments and optional end predicate, returning a CommandResult.
